title: 第13章 再查下去你们都要死第14章 花城盛会
slug: 狂仙出狱第2234章龙主燃尽
content_zh:
“糕点有毒！
？”
听到陈凡的话，洛千凝瞬间汗毛直立。
陈凡为了证明自己说的都是真的，立刻将一根银针插入糕点之中。
果然，银针发黑！
原本一场开心的饭局，瞬间变得气氛紧张起来。
“小昭！”
洛千凝叫道。
李昭昭闻言立刻走了进来，强压着看到陈凡和洛千凝坐在一起的不悦问道：“小姐，有何吩咐？”
“立刻去把胡凤仙找来，让她关店谁也不许离开，刚才送来的这盘糕点有毒！”
洛千凝寒着脸说道。
“什么！
有人下毒！
？”
李昭昭立刻意识到了问题的严重性。
前不久洛千凝才刚被毒蛇咬伤，现在又有人在她饭中下毒，绝对不可能是巧合！
“我立刻去办！”
李昭昭气势汹汹地找到了老板娘胡凤仙，在通过一个个的仔细排查后，很快就找到了下毒之人。
那是一名乔装打扮成服务员的女人，被抓住后，对方非但没有害怕，反而态度极其嚣张。
啪！

啪！
胡凤仙狠狠地抽了女人两个耳光：“你这个王八蛋知不知道洛小姐是什么身份，你想害死我吗？”
她真是气不打一处来，如果洛千凝在凤仙居出了意外，自己就算是有一百条命都不够死的！
可惜，无论胡凤仙带着手下如何报复，下毒的女子却只是冷笑连连，不屑地看着他们。
最后下毒的女子用恶毒的目光看向陈凡。
“小子，你多管闲事干什么？你这是在自寻死路！
知道吗？”
女人威胁道。
“呵呵，区区一个五毒教就能吓得住我？”
陈凡早已看穿了对方的身份。
上次咬伤洛千凝的毒蛇，就是五毒教人饲养的。
女子闻言微微诧异，显然是没有想到陈凡竟然能洞悉自己的身份。
“口气真不小，有本事你就陪着她继续查下去好了，我保证你最后死的一定会很惨！
哈哈哈哈……”
女子狂笑着，口中忽然流出了一股黑血。
为了不再继续受折磨，她竟然毅然决然地服毒自尽了！
“查什么？”
陈凡满头雾水，他根本不知道说的到底是什么意思。
但，陈凡观察到洛千凝的脸色很不好看。
“洛小姐实在对不起，是我监管不力，竟然没有发现有杀手混入这里，您要怎么惩罚我都行。”

胡凤仙站在原地瑟瑟发抖，等待着洛千凝的责罚。
然而令她意想不到的是，洛千凝只是摇摇头：“算了，不关你的事，那些人想要对我动手，你们防不住的。”
“陈先生说的五毒教到底是什么人啊？他们吃了熊心豹子胆吗？竟然敢对洛小姐您下毒？”
胡凤仙好奇地问道。
洛千凝摆摆手没有细说，显然这不是一般人能接触的秘密。
content_en:
“The pastries are poisonous!
? "
Hearing Chen Fan's words, Luo Qianning's hair stood on end instantly.
In order to prove that what he said was true, Chen Fan immediately inserted a silver needle into the pastry.
Sure enough, the silver needle turned black!
What was originally a happy dinner suddenly became tense.
"Xiao Zhao!"
Luo Qianning shouted.
Li Zhaozhao walked in immediately after hearing this, suppressed his displeasure at seeing Chen Fan and Luo Qianning sitting together and asked, "Miss, what are your orders?"
"Go find Hu Fengxian immediately and ask her to close the shop and no one is allowed to leave. The plate of cakes just delivered is poisonous!"
Luo Qianning said with a cold face.
"What!
Someone poisoned!
? "
Li Zhaozhao immediately realized the seriousness of the problem.
Luo Qianning was bitten by a poisonous snake not long ago, and now someone poisoned her food. It couldn't be a coincidence!
"I'll do it immediately!"
Li Zhaozhao found the proprietress Hu Fengxian aggressively. After careful investigation one by one, he quickly found the poisoner.
It was a woman disguised as a waiter. After she was caught, instead of being afraid, the other party had an extremely arrogant attitude.
Snap!
Snap!
Hu Fengxian slapped the woman twice hard: "You bastard, do you know who Miss Luo is? Do you want to kill me?"
She was really furious. If Luo Qianning had an accident in Fengxianju, she would not be able to die even if she had a hundred lives!
Unfortunately, no matter how Hu Fengxian and his men tried to retaliate, the poisoned woman just sneered and looked at them with disdain.
The woman who poisoned him in the end looked at Chen Fan with vicious eyes.
"Boy, why are you meddling in other people's business? You are asking for death!
Do you know? "
the woman threatened.
"Haha, can a mere Five Poison Sect scare me?"
Chen Fan had already seen through the other party's identity.
The venomous snake that bit Luo Qianning last time was raised by the Five Poison Cult.
The woman was slightly surprised when she heard this, obviously she did not expect that Chen Fan could actually understand her identity.
"That's not a small tone. If you have the ability, just accompany her to continue the investigation. I guarantee that your death will be miserable in the end!"
Hahahaha..."
The woman laughed wildly, and a stream of black blood suddenly flowed from her mouth.
In order not to continue to be tortured, she resolutely committed suicide by taking poison!
"What to check?"
Chen Fan was confused, he had no idea what he meant.
However, Chen Fan observed that Luo Qianning's face looked very ugly.
"Miss Luo, I'm really sorry. It's because of my poor supervision that I didn't find a killer sneaking into this place. You can punish me however you want."
Hu Fengxian stood there shivering, waiting for Luo Qianning's punishment.
However, what she didn't expect was that Luo Qianning just shook her head: "Forget it, it's none of your business. If those people want to attack me, you can't prevent them."
"Who are the Five Poison Sect that Mr. Chen is talking about? Did they eat the gall of a bear's heart and a leopard's heart? How dare they poison you, Miss Luo?"
Hu Fengxian asked curiously.
Luo Qianning waved her hands and did not elaborate. Obviously this was not a secret accessible to ordinary people.
